name: spotify-friend-activity
description: Firefox Add-on to view your friends' activity in Spotify's web player

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && webpack && npm run copy:dist
scripts.copy:dist: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); ['src/components/Popup/popup.html', 'src/injectInterceptor.js', 'src/sfaInterceptor.js', 'manifest.json'].forEach((file) => fs.copyFileSync(file, path.join('dist', path.basename(file))))"
